solver_notes: Metadata repo python/cpython is inconsistent with lockless_queue.c; this is a native C lock-free stack regression model, not a claimed CPython patch. The fixed head is a 16-byte pointer+uint64_t epoch pair. Every successful pop/push increments the epoch; explicit AArch64 LDAXP/STLXP CAS compares both words, so an A->B->A address recycle cannot satisfy the original expected pair and the operation retries. The deterministic pthread interleaving proves legacy resurrection of already-popped B and fixed preservation of C. Stress uses four pthreads, 50000 iterations each, and exactly-once validation of all 128 nodes. Nodes remain allocated until threads join; epoch tagging addresses ABA, not a general safe-memory-reclamation scheme. Initial harness build had an atomic_store macro/comma error and was corrected. Default GCC 16-byte atomics called libatomic and failed the lock-free gate; those results are not claimed as passes. The final binary uses explicit ARMv8 LDAXP/STLXP and disassembly contains no __atomic_load_16 or __atomic_compare_exchange_16 calls. file_sha256_of_this_json is SHA-256 of the compact JSON preimage with this digest field empty.
